place_fields.summary: Open-air museum displaying vintage locomotives and railway history.

planning_attributes.description: Museum dedicated to Indian railway history, with vintage locomotives and coaches.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The museum was established in 1979 and is described as an outdoor exhibit of vintage locomotives; it also presents railway photographs, paintings, signals and lights.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Krishnaraja Sagar Road, opposite the Central Food Technology and Research Institute.
